component.name: PaketScope
component.summary: Inspect and manage installed Linux applications

description.p: PaketScope gives you a searchable view of applications installed on a Debian-family desktop, from APT/dpkg and Flatpak.
Package changes go through APT itself: every install, remove, or purge is simulated first, shown to you for confirmation, and re-simulated before it runs. It never runs a bulk upgrade or autoremove.
This is a development preview (3.0.0~dev5). It is currently validated for Debian 13 only.
Adds AppStream metadata and the developer profile shown by software centers. Exposes the Flatpak branch in details; no other behaviour change.
Development preview: APT/dpkg and Flatpak inventory, confirmed APT install, remove, and purge.
